review.plain: Coercion in the second degree is committing coercion in the third degree and thereby compelling or inducing a person to engage in vaginal, oral or anal sexual contact; it is a class E felony.

penalties.penalty: Class E felony (sentence set in Penal Law Article 70)

conditions: Commits the crime of coercion in the third degree as defined in section 135.60 of this article

review.plain: Coercion and certain bribe receiving crimes are not mutually exclusive, and committing one of those bribe receiving crimes by the same conduct is no defense to a coercion prosecution.
Sets an affirmative defense to coercion by threat of criminal charges where the defendant reasonably believed the charge true and sought only reasonable action to make good the wrong.
